name: 25hours Hotel Jakarta The Oddbird
short_description: A 5-star lifestyle hotel rising 38 stories above ASHTA Mall in Jakarta's SCBD, with 210 rooms plus 135 serviced apartments, holding a 4.7/5 ALL Rating (1,281 reviews).
ai_summary: 25hours Hotel Jakarta The Oddbird is a 5-star lifestyle property in District8, part of Jakarta's Sudirman Central Business District (SCBD). The 38-story tower has 210 rooms and 135 serviced apartments rising above ASHTA Mall in the Senopati area, with eclectic design, dining, wellness facilities, and skyline views. The hotel holds a 4.7/5 ALL Rating from 1,281 reviews on its own Accor page. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
